name: electronic-circuit-designer-and-simulator
description: Interactive 3D Electronic Circuit Designer & Simulator (ESP32, Sensors, OLED, Breadboard, Simulation Engine)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:client: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client

author: Creative Engineering
